classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught sector-perimeter formula, identifying radii from diameters where necessary.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter of these shapes. Answer to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Unshaded quadrant centred at its upper-left vertex, with horizontal and downward radii and a right-angle square.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given radius and right-angle mark are visible.

spec.description: Rotated unshaded quadrant with centre at the lower-left vertex; lower radius slopes slightly downwards to the right.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given radius and right-angle mark are visible.

spec.description: Unshaded semicircle below a diameter sloping upwards to the right, with a red midpoint marker.
spec.answerVisibility: The diameter measurement and centre marker are visible; the derived radius is not printed.

spec.description: Unshaded semicircle below-left of a diameter sloping downwards to the right, with a red midpoint marker.
spec.answerVisibility: The diameter measurement and centre marker are visible; the derived radius is not printed.

spec.description: Unshaded sector with bottom vertex, nearly vertical left radius, upper-right radius and interior angle arc.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given radius and central angle are visible.

spec.description: Unshaded obtuse sector with horizontal right radius and upper-left radius.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given radius and central angle are visible.
